width.contract_source: local_operator/slash_commands.py — the picker's description column is 46 cells at a 100-column terminal and 56 at 110; /help folds past ~55 cells
width.counting_method: per-character cell count, combining marks excluded, W/F wide glyphs = 2; validated against the vi style guide's own recorded figures (wire.slash.fork: vi 81 / en 74 — both reproduced exactly)
width.cost_of_this_revision: Three changed values are longer than their en source (mobile 53 vs 51, provider 52 vs 42, session 59 vs 54); only session crosses the 56-cell column that its en source stays inside. agent/mcp/stop exceed 55, but so do their en sources, so the revision did not introduce that.
width.prior_receipt_width_claim_correction: The previous receipt recorded a 51-cell picker budget and '50 of 52 values fit'. Recomputed on the bytes, 8 en values and 6 vi values exceed 55 cells and en itself exceeds 56 in six places, so that width block is not reliable evidence of fit. This audit measured afresh; the figures above come from this tree, not from the prior report.

findings.en: Usage, cost, diagnostics; --copy copies the session ID
findings.current: Lượng sử dụng, chi phí, chẩn đoán; --copy sao chép ID phiên
findings.problem: The revision correctly restored the verb that was missing ('--copy: ID phiên' said nothing about copying), but pushed the line 3 cells past the 56-cell description column the picker measures at a 110-column terminal, and past the ~55 at which /help folds. The en source at 54 renders whole. Where it clips, the clip lands on 'ID phiên' — the exact clause this revision added, so the added information is the part that gets cut. Meaning in the catalogue is intact; the loss is in the rendered row.
findings.suggestion: Lượng sử dụng, chi phí, chẩn đoán; --copy lấy ID phiên
findings.fix_note: 'lấy ID phiên' keeps the verb sense ('--copy takes the session ID') and the guide's pinned term «lượng sử dụng», and fits the column at 54. If 'sao chép' is preferred as the standard UI verb, the honest alternative is 'chép ID phiên' at 55; keeping 'sao chép' as written means accepting a 3-cell clip and an ellipsis on this row.

findings.en: Open Hub links — per-link subscribe and auto-push policy
findings.current: Mở liên kết Hub — theo dõi/tự đẩy cho từng liên kết
findings.problem: Both previous losses are gone. What remains is register: en's noun 'policy' (its sidecar note calls these the two per-link toggles) is not rendered, and the slash reads as an either/or between the two settings where en couples them with 'and'.
findings.suggestion: Mở liên kết Hub — theo dõi và tự đẩy cho từng liên kết

findings.en: List MCP servers; add/remove one, or manage an OAuth grant
findings.current: Liệt kê máy chủ MCP; add/remove, quản lý cấp quyền OAuth
findings.problem: 'one' after add/remove is still unrendered, so the line no longer says the subverbs act on a single server. No change recommended: 'add/remove một' measures 60 cells, past the column, and the quantifier is recoverable from the subverb vocabulary.

findings.en: Show or hide conversations; 'focus' keys the list
findings.current: Hiện/ẩn cuộc trò chuyện; “focus” điều hướng phím
findings.problem: Quotes are now the guide's “ ” (fixed). The leftover drift: en says the word 'focus' moves keyboard focus to the list; 'điều hướng phím' reads as 'keyboard navigation', describing navigation rather than focusing the list.
findings.suggestion: Hiện/ẩn cuộc trò chuyện; “focus” đưa phím vào danh sách
